text:
The dish looks like a small paper plate, probably about 18-20 cm across, though the image shows it at roughly 260 px. The almonds fill about 180 px, so about 13 cm, in a heap.

I count roughly 40 almonds. An almond weighs about 1.2 g, so that comes to about 48 g. Almonds run about 5.8 kcal/g, so 48 g is about 280 kcal.

The pile looks fairly dense and may be two layers deep, so the count could be nearer 45 to 50. I'll take about 55 g and 320 kcal.

{"kcal": 320, "mass_g": 55}
